Step 1

Verify that the XOVR Toolpath recording interface has appeared correctly, displaying the recording controls with REC button, timer, and playback options in the center of the screen.

Step 2

Confirm that the XOVR Toolpath dialog window is displayed with the title "XOVR Toolpath" and the message "Recording in progress. Use the toolbar to pause or stop."
